summary: DeepMind researchers publish a position paper arguing that AI research should shift from a solipsistic, unilateral-optimization paradigm toward a cooperative, non-stationary paradigm that accounts for multi-agent interdependence and preserves human agency.

practices.reason: The paper calls for building dynamic evaluation testbeds with adaptive counterparties, a methodological direction but not a concrete instrument an engineering team could run today.
practices.quote: This entails building dynamic evaluation testbeds involving adaptive counterparties, treating institutions as design primitives, and preserving human agency as a structural feature of the systems we build.
